entities.name: UniProt Q5LWD3
observations: Exact 151-aa sequence match to reviewed Ruegeria pomeroyi deoxyuridine 5'-triphosphate nucleotidohydrolase; Swiss-Prot annotation assigns EC 3.6.1.23.
Annotated reaction: dUTP + H2O → dUMP + diphosphate + H+; magnesium ion cofactor.
Sequence-derived properties: 151 aa, estimated molecular mass 15,629.6 Da, theoretical pI 5.675.
